caption: The video captures a dark asphalt-shingle roof viewed at an oblique angle, with rows running diagonally and a shadowed region at the upper-left corner. Small white hail pellets rest across the textured surface, while short bright streaks move downward through the air over the roof. The camera remains fixed, keeping the shingle grid and upper border aligned from frame to frame. Falling hail appears as blurred white lines at changing positions, some near the left side, others over the center and right rows. The streaks descend toward the shingles, while the scattered resting dots remain broadly in place, with no large clearing of the surface. The roof surface looks damp and dark, with bright spots scattered among the resting hail pellets. Hail continues to fall throughout the visible segment, leaving the process ongoing rather than showing a beginning or end.
